threads.assignment: Shared contracts and hub files only. Add TransactionPropagation, the propagation field on TransactionOptions and LoadStrategy.BALANCED to packages/core/src/enums.ts; add processOnCreateHooksEarly (default false) and accept 'balanced' for loadStrategy in packages/core/src/utils/Configuration.ts; make the shared type changes in packages/core/src/typings.ts, packages/core/src/drivers/IDatabaseDriver.ts and packages/knex/src/typings.ts; export defineEntity and TransactionManager through the package index files (a stub module per API with the exact signature from the roadmap is enough; other threads implement them). packages/core/src/EntityManager.ts, packages/knex/src/AbstractSqlDriver.ts and the loading-strategy helpers in packages/core/src/entity/utils.ts are shared by several targets, so this thread makes every roadmap change to them: em.transactional() delegating to TransactionManager (Target 2), the balanced loading strategy (Target 3), the relation-filter handling in those files (Target 4), and the processOnCreateHooksEarly option on em.create() (Target 5). Nothing else.

Target 1 (Declarative Entity Definition): implement defineEntity, defineEntity.properties, the scalar, relation, embedded and enum builders and InferEntity in packages/core/src/entity/defineEntity.ts.

Target 2 (Transaction Propagation): implement TransactionManager and its seven propagation modes in packages/core/src/utils/TransactionManager.ts, TransactionStateError in packages/core/src/errors.ts, the contextName option in packages/core/src/decorators/Transactional.ts, and any connection-level transaction changes in packages/core/src/connections/Connection.ts and packages/knex/src/AbstractSqlConnection.ts. em.transactional() and the enum belong to t0.

Target 4 (Relation Filter Improvements) and Target 5 (Early onCreate Hook Processing): apply filters and populateWhere as join conditions on to-one relations in the query builder and criteria nodes (packages/knex/src/query) and in relation loading (packages/core/src/entity/EntityLoader.ts, ArrayCollection.ts), and run onCreate hooks inside em.create() when processOnCreateHooksEarly is enabled in packages/core/src/entity/EntityFactory.ts. The EntityManager and SQL driver sides belong to t0.
